question: 完成K/G包级诊断后，扩大到四种来源规则×两种初体的八个新变异候选，探索真实形成形态和动态；为后续经历/环境适应实验保留多样身体。此次只筛形成，不检验学习。

genome.sampler: one PCG64(seed_start+source_index) uniform(-1,1,11) vector per source; take abs of component kernel_crossmix
genome.base_genes: all zero relative to exact declared source life0
genome.phenotype_construction: Reuse the defined nonrigid stretch/neck, normalized radial-kernel tilt and convex mixing, log response shifts and weight shift semantics of frozen genome.py. New wrapper/export only, do not edit old frozen modules. Interpolation/kernel normalization are explicit NEW candidate operations, never a factorial exact-copy claim.
genome.invalid: Retain invalid proposal and reason; no automatic resample, repair, retry, replacement or budget transfer; native count may be below eight.
genome.inheritance: explicit source ID/hash, child content ID, parent_id, generation=1, seed and all actual arrays; rules fixed within each lifetime

initialization.embedding: literal centered zero pad, 16:80; all outside fields including P/F zero; integer-displacement kernels unchanged after embedding
initialization.body_mass: same as each source; no extra mass
initialization.energy: .8*rho using original neutral builder semantics; save actual values and roundoff
initialization.neutral: original life0 neutral history/held fields and declared coupled founder/polarity; no reached state as fresh life
initialization.host: original experience_adaptation_host build/save/open; exact actual export roundtrip; no new physics

stages.old_source_steps: 0 replay; historical 64-grid formation is context only, not a matched parent control

environment.tape: use only t=1..128 with tape[t-1]; no new forcing or selection by previews
environment.physics: existing dt=.05, density capacity, conversion, .2+.2+.02 birth components and original fees unchanged

evaluation.primary: Describe all valid candidates and failures; no single scalar winner or adaptation eligibility.
outputs: actual raw body frames in fixed coordinates and density scale, initial and every8 steps to128
saved full ready packets and true extinction/zero tails
shape descriptors: holes, components, elongation, spread plus observed motion/turnover; finite grid caveats
parent/source lineage and new kernel/response/body arrays
all late positive and negative intervals; no stable organism claim from finite survival
evaluation.archive: Exploration-only, retain distinct live morphodynamics and all failures; if same niche collides retain full records and do not select solely by mass. Actual inspection required; do not label static genome differences as dynamic diversity.
evaluation.contrasts: No assertion that new 96 offspring improve over old 64 parents; two already evaluated matching 96 parents can be referenced only when exact source/config/tape/timing match, never rerun old paths.

execution.flow: d3 actual exports and SHA manifest -> ce2 only necessary new construction/host boundary checks -> freeze plan/source hashes and one keyed submission; no additional PI approval once manifest satisfies this contract
execution.stop: at128 or run-control stop; no additional injury/history/extension or automatic parameter subdivision
